physicalNotes: No radius or mass of the Local Void is recorded: it is an extended region with few galaxies, and its package frames it at 30000000 pc (object.json worldFrame.bodyRadiusM), a presentation value: half the mean of the published dimensions, 69, 51 and 60 Mpc.

sources.position: Supergalactic SGX, SGY, SGZ = [+22, -9, +22] Mpc: the lowest density of the Local Void in the Cosmicflows-3 reconstruction (Tully et al. (2019), Cosmicflows-3: Cosmography of the Local Void, ApJ 880, 24, https://arxiv.org/abs/1905.08329), turned to ICRS with the RC3 supergalactic frame (pole at galactic l 47.37, b 6.32; origin at l 137.37, b 0) and the IAU 1958 galactic frame.
sources.distance: 32390000 pc: the length of the published position [+22, -9, +22] Mpc, which the paper converts from [+1650, -700, +1650] km/s with H0 = 75 km/s/Mpc (https://arxiv.org/abs/1905.08329).
sources.properMotion: Zero: the region with few galaxies is held at its published position; no motion across the sky is applied.
sources.radialVelocity: The length of the published velocity-space position [+1650, -700, +1650] km/s: Tully et al. (2019), Cosmicflows-3: Cosmography of the Local Void, ApJ 880, 24 (https://arxiv.org/abs/1905.08329)
